data_fields.name: minimap_cell_px
data_fields.donor_constant: 4 when terrain drawing or coding is off; 8 if larger map side > 60; 16 if > 40; else 24

data_fields.name: hex_fill_fraction
data_fields.donor_constant: three quarters of the cell width

data_fields.name: terrain_minimap_rgb
data_fields.donor_constant: fourth hex value per colour range, e.g. cave 3C355C, reef 2F8399

data_fields.name: owner_colour_prefs
data_fields.donor_constant: own (unmoved), enemy and allied colours from viewer preferences

data_fields.name: neutral_village_rgb
data_fields.donor_constant: third hex of the white range, 1E1E1E (a defect candidate, see gaps)

best_idea: Colour each hub on the minimap by its owner relative to the viewer (mine, enemy, allied, neutral), hide anything in shroud or fog, and dim terrain that is seen before but not now rather than erasing it.
decision_why: The owner-relative hub colour and the three-state fog fit camps and towns in zones; the hex layout does not fit zones, the neutral colour needs its own data key, the missing-colour hole needs a fallback, and the fog dim must be a ratio.
acceptance: A hub owned by the player's faction shows in the mine colour, an enemy hub in the enemy colour and a neutral hub in its own neutral colour; a hub in fog is not drawn; a zone of 61 or more tiles a side uses 8 px cells and one of 41 to 60 uses 16 px.
